platformDescription.title: About the platform
platformDescription.subtitle:
A community supporting
Ukrainian artists
platformDescription.paragraph1: We are building a nationwide platform for individuals from various cultural fields whose professional qualifications carry high creative potential for producing unique works of art that artistically reinterpret contemporary historical events and the state of humanity, promote peace, and enrich the world's artistic heritage.
platformDescription.paragraph2: To help overcome the global cultural crisis in a country standing guard for peace throughout the world, we provide an opportunity to shape a new artistic heritage that conveys the art of victory and protects future generations from ruin.
